rows.ja: 顧客・利用企業(各社の年次報告に記載)
rows.en: Customers & users (named in their annual reports)

relations.text: Asanaの年次報告が、顧客の支払い方法にPayPalを挙げている
relations.text_en: Asana's annual report names PayPal among payment methods its customers use

source.label: Asana 10-K
source.quote: A large portion of our customers authorize us to bill their credit card accounts or bill them via other payment methods, such as PayPal or other direct debit methods, through our third-party payment processing partners for our paid subscription plans.

companies.name: Roblox
companies.sub: ゲームプラットフォーム

relations.text: Robloxの年次報告が、Robux購入の入金経路にPayPalを挙げている
relations.text_en: Roblox's annual report lists PayPal among channels for receiving cash proceeds from Robux purchases

source.label: Roblox 10-K
source.quote: We utilize these distribution channels, such as Amazon, Apple, Blackhawk, ePay, Google, Incomm, PayPal, Stripe, Microsoft, Sony’s PlayStation Network, and Xsolla, to receive cash proceeds from purchases of Robux.

companies.name: DoorDash
companies.sub: 宅配プラットフォーム

relations.text: DoorDashの年次報告が、StripeおよびPayPalと商用契約を結んでいると述べている
relations.text_en: DoorDash's annual report says it has commercial agreements with Stripe and PayPal

source.label: DoorDash 10-K
source.quote: Under our commercial agreements with Stripe and PayPal, each of these parties may terminate our relationship with advanced notice.

relations.text: StripeとPayPalの双方が契約を終了すれば、DoorDashは代替の決済事業者を探す必要がある
relations.text_en: If both Stripe and PayPal terminate, DoorDash would need to find alternate payment processors

source.label: DoorDash 10-K
source.quote: If both Stripe and PayPal terminate their relationship with us or refuse to renew their agreements with us on commercially reasonable terms, we would be required to find alternate payment processors and may not be able to secure similar terms or a suitable replacement in an acceptable time frame.

relations.text: Shopifyの年次報告が、PayPalとの契約は初期期間後、12か月ごとに自動更新されると述べている
relations.text_en: Shopify's annual report says the PayPal agreement renews automatically every 12 months after its initial term

source.label: Shopify 10-K
source.quote: The PayPal agreement, following its initial term, automatically renews every 12 months, unless either party terminates the agreement earlier.

relations.text: PayPalがOpenAIと提携し、Agentic Commerce Protocolを採用する
relations.text_en: PayPal is partnering with OpenAI and adopting the Agentic Commerce Protocol

source.label: PayPal — OpenAI agentic-commerce partnership, October 28, 2025
source.quote: "By partnering with OpenAI and adopting the Agentic Commerce Protocol, PayPal will power payments and commerce experiences that help people go from chat to checkout in just a few taps for our joint customer bases."

relations.text: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.などが参加するクレジット契約(2023年6月7日付)をPayPalが締結している
relations.text_en: PayPal has a credit agreement dated June 7, 2023 with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. among the parties

source.label: PayPal 10-K
source.quote: Credit Agreement, dated as of June 7, 2023, among PayPal Holdings, Inc. the Designated Borrowers party thereto, the Lenders party thereto and JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. and J.P.
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: Wells Fargo Bank, National Associationを受託者とする社債の信託証書(2019年9月26日付)がある
relations.text_en: PayPal has an indenture dated September 26, 2019 with Wells Fargo Bank, National Association as trustee

source.label: PayPal 10-K
source.quote: Officer’s Certificate, dated as of September 26, 2019, pursuant to the Indenture, dated as of September 26, 2019, by and between PayPal Holdings, Inc. and Wells Fargo Bank, National Association, as Trustee, containing Forms of 2026 Note and 2029 Note
source.note: 受託者としての関係のみです。

relations.text: 同信託証書に基づく2030年債・2050年債の役員証明書(2020年5月18日付)がある
relations.text_en: An Officer's Certificate dated May 18, 2020 covers the 2030 and 2050 Notes under the same indenture

source.label: PayPal 10-K
source.quote: Officer’s Certificate, dated as of May 18, 2020, pursuant to the Indenture, dated as of September 26, 2019, by and between PayPal Holdings, Inc. and Wells Fargo Bank, National Association, as Trustee, containing Forms of 2030 Note and 2050 Note

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
